name: sputActor_FreeActor
comment: Removes the actor from its set, kills shadows, frees costumes, walker, extra and colormap reference
Draws the actor's shadow onto one shadow plane: every mesh face of each model is projected through the plane, clipped to each of the plane's sectors and drawn with shadow.mat / shadow.cmp
shadow.mat material used for actor shadows
shadow.cmp colormap used for actor shadows

name: Costume_InitRecord
comment: 0xb4-byte costume record: [0] CHORE.DLL instance, [1] costume resource, [2] component list, [3-5] head joints, [6-8] head limits, [9] look rate, [10-13] walk/left/right/rest chores, [14-29] talk chores, [30] mumble chore, [44] next

name: Costume_GetMainModel
comment: rdThing of the first MMDL component

name: Sector_SetType
comment: Stores the type bits (+0x24); 0x1000 sets a small shrink tolerance, 0x100 (edge sector) needs 4 vertices and picks the long axis (+0x78)

name: SectorList_SelectForSet
comment: Points g_pWalkPlane_wp_head at the sector list cached for the named set (table of 0x28-byte {list, name} entries)

name: Sector_EdgeFollowDirection
comment: For a 4-vertex edge sector: direction along the edge the walker should follow (g_vEdgeFollowDir), stepping the current edge index when the walker reaches a corner

name: Walker_GetAngles
comment: Converts the walker's 3x3 frame to pitch/yaw/roll in g_vWalkerAngles

name: Sector_ClipPolygon
proto: int __thiscall Sector_ClipPolygon(void * this, float * verts, int count, float * out)
comment: Sutherland-Hodgman clip of a polygon against the sector's edges in its projection plane; returns the vertex count
